name: Alchemy FM Channel Designer
author: MMagTech
description: Design live radio channels in AudioMuse using CLAP, lyrics, mood clusters, and Song Alchemy — preview programming, then deploy to Alchemy FM.

versions.changelog: Saved designs that were never deployed now appear under Your Stations with a 'Not Deployed' badge and can be deleted (drafts from Suggest Programming used to accumulate forever with no removal path). Genre filters now match subgenres — 'rock' also matches 'hard rock' and 'classic rock' instead of requiring an exact match — and the filter feedback counts tracks that have no genre metadata. Deploys now surface a warning when Alchemy FM's Icecast is out of source slots, so a saved-but-off-air station says why instead of looking successfully deployed.

Rename the Chat Designer buttons and refresh copy that went stale as features were added. 'Generate Playlist Preview' is now 'Suggest Programming' (it never produced a playlist - it sets a Step 2 query, and 'playlist' already means a Navidrome playlist elsewhere in this plugin) and 'Design Full Station' is now 'Draft Whole Station' (it fills Steps 1, 2 and 5, not everything). The panel hint described only the preview path even though it sat under both buttons. Step 2's explainer did not list the Journey type; Step 5's did not mention Smooth Transitions or Time-of-Day Energy at all. Panel subtitles and the build-a-station overview updated to match.
